title: Persona Perspectives: Adopting Viewpoints Reorganizes Representations in LLMs
abstract: arXiv:2611.06848v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Common methods for monitoring features in large language models (LLMs) such as linear probes and sparse autoencoders (SAEs) assume that features maintain a consistent representation across contexts. LLMs, however, can flexibly adopt different perspectives or "personas" that suggest different underlying systems of conceptual relations. In this paper, we examine whether prompting an LLM to adopt a persona alters the representational geometry of the model's latent space. We extract representations of over 9,000 common words and 33 semantic axes from models adopting liberal and conservative political personas and compare these against two neutral baselines. We find that persona conditioning systematically alters both the projections of words onto semantic axes and the alignments among the axes themselves in directions consistent with the specified ideology. We then test the implications of this reorganization for two safety-relevant features

translated_title: 人格视角：采用不同观点会重组大语言模型中的表征
translated_abstract: 常见的大语言模型（LLM）特征监控方法，如线性探针和稀疏自编码器（SAE），都假设特征在不同上下文中保持一致的表征。然而，LLM能够灵活地采用不同的视角或“人格”，这些视角暗示着不同的底层概念关系系统。在本文中，我们研究了促使LLM采用某种人格是否会改变模型潜在空间的表征几何结构。我们从采用自由派和保守派政治人格的模型中提取了超过9,000个常用词和33个语义轴的表征，并与两个中性基线进行比较。我们发现，人格条件化会系统地改变词语在语义轴上的投影以及语义轴之间的对齐方式，且这些变化方向与指定的意识形态一致。随后，我们测试了这种表征重组对两个安全相关特征的影响。
tldr: 该研究发现让大语言模型采用特定人格视角（如政治意识形态）会系统地重组其潜在空间的表征几何结构，这对假设特征表征跨上下文保持一致的线性探针和稀疏自编码器等安全监控方法构成了挑战。
en_tdlr: Adopting personas (e.g., political ideologies) systematically reorganizes the representational geometry of LLM latent space, challenging feature monitoring methods like linear probes and SAEs that assume consistent feature representations across contexts.
